scientific_integrity: The paper’s previously known stationary position tail and marginal saddle are acknowledged, not claimed as new. Conditional-history theorem has an analytic proof; checker provides finite independent-method numerical corroboration, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional independent Brownian drivers; strictly positive fixed reset/diffusivity parameters; complete simultaneous position/diffusivity resetting; only asymptotic high stationary position, not finite-sample inference or first-passage histories. A broader unlocated Gaussian-chaos conditioning theorem could reduce originality. Independent peer validation has not occurred.
title: Rare-excursion history selection in a Brownian-diffusivity reset bath
